summary: Eps 1-21 adapt manga chs 1-90 nearly linearly across three missions: Onion Alien (chs 1-25, eps 1-5), Tanaka Alien (chs 26-55, eps 5-14), Buddhist Temple (chs 56-91, eps 15-21). The S1/S2 boundary is clean: ep 13 ends at ch 53 (mid-Tanaka aftermath), ep 14 opens at ch 54. Ep 21 compresses chs 80-90 into one episode and alters the mission ending; eps 22-26 are a wholly anime-original ending (the 'Kill Kei Kurono' filler arc) replacing the manga's continuation from ch 91 — honest continue point after the series is ch 90. The gantz.fandom episode infoboxes carry an 'Adopted' chapter range per episode (eps 5-7 have a copy-paste corruption, resolved via the chapter pages' reverse mapping and summary correlation), and the wiki's chapter-page volume fields match our stored volume boundaries exactly. The existing ep26→ch280 v25 anchor is a Gantz:O MOVIE endpoint (vol 25 ch 280) mistakenly attached to TV ep 26 and must be removed.

repairs.why: Anchor is bogus: ep 26 is anime-original filler (no manga counterpart — fandom ep page has no Adopted field; animefillerlist and the fandom 'Filler episodes' page both mark 22-26 filler). Vol 25 / ch 280 is the endpoint of the Gantz:O MOVIE (MAL stack lists 'Ends at Vol 8, Chap 91 (TV), Original Ending Ep 22-26 / Vol 25, Chap 280 (Gantz:O)') — the MU-derived anchor conflated the movie with TV ep 26. Remove the anchor entirely.

structure.notes: Two 13-episode seasons ('First Stage' eps 1-13 Fuji TV, 'Second Stage' eps 14-26 AT-X from 2004-08-26), direct continuation, cumulative numbering matches components; no OVAs/movies in the TV order (Gantz:O adapts chs 238-280 and is unrelated to this chain). Chapter space = mainline fandom numbering 1-383, matching context; fandom chapter-page volume fields (v2 starts ch 11, v3 ch 23, v4 ch 35, v5 ch 47, v6 ch 59, v7 ch 71, v8 ch 83, v9 ch 95) match stored volume boundaries exactly. Adaptation is linear ep-by-ep through ch 90; arc map: Onion chs 1-25 = eps 1-5, Tanaka chs 26-55 = eps 5-14, Buddhist Temple chs 56-91 = eps 15-21.
